---
title: FAQ
description: "Short answers to what it is, what it runs, and what happens to your files and data."
---

| What you want to do | What does it | Where it runs |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Read or edit a study | the modeler | your browser |
| Administer a study to participants | the browser runner | your browser |
| Execute an analysis pipeline | the Python runner | your machine |
| Convert, check, or render a file | the CLI | your machine |

## What it is

| Question | Answer |
|:--|:--|
| **What is Studyflow?** | A coordination notation for research: one file states an experiment's order, its branches, and its data flow, in the role BPMN 2.0 plays for business processes. Your tools compute; the file coordinates them. [Introduction](index.qmd). |
| **Who is it for?** | Researchers who design experiments with participants, and researchers who build analysis pipelines or evaluate models. The same elements serve both. [One file, many views](index.qmd#one-file-many-views). |
| **Why build on BPMN?** | BPMN 2.0 (ISO/IEC 19510) already standardizes steps, branches, events, and data, so Studyflow extends a notation people know instead of inventing one. The modeler exports BPMN 2.0 XML and opens `.bpmn` files drawn elsewhere. [BPMN mapping](reference/bpmn.qmd). |

## Using it

| Question | Answer |
|:--|:--|
| **Do I need to install anything?** | Not to draw or administer a study: the [modeler](https://behaverse.org/studyflow-modeler/app.html) and the [browser runner](run/participants.qmd) are web pages. Install the Python runner and the CLI only to execute an analysis pipeline. |
| **Can I actually run a study?** | Yes: the browser runner administers consent, instructions, questionnaires, and Behaverse tasks; the Python runner executes analysis steps that name a Python callable. [Execution](run/execution.qmd) has the element-by-element account. |
| **Can I use my own tasks?** | Name the package and the version on the task --- jsPsych, PsychoPy, Unity --- and that naming travels with the file. The browser runner administers Behaverse tasks itself, and shows the step and the software it names for other packages. |
| **Can it randomize participants into arms?** | Yes: a diamond marked with dice assigns each participant at random, and a pinned seed repeats those draws exactly. For allocation balanced across a cohort, allocate outside the study and pass the arm in --- [Randomize and counterbalance](design/randomization.qmd). |

## Your files and your data

| Question | Answer |
|:--|:--|
| **Does anything leave my browser?** | Not until you send it: your work stays in your browser's storage until you export a file, publish it, or switch run recording on. |
| **Is a picture really the file?** | Yes --- a `.studyflow.png` or `.studyflow.svg` export carries the whole study inside the image, and opens back up in the modeler fully editable. |
| **How does Studyflow relate to Psych-DS, BIDS, or CSVW?** | Complementary: they describe the data, Studyflow describes the process around it, and a studyflow points at them through the `schema` attribute on a dataset or a table. [Data in and out](design/data.qmd#say-what-the-columns-hold). |
| **Can I use it without a Behaverse account?** | Yes: a `.studyflow.yaml` file is plain-text YAML you can render, diff, share, and version anywhere ([Keep, share, and publish](run/share.qmd)). An account is needed only to publish a study to the Behaverse Data Server and collect participant data there. |
| **Is the format stable?** | The BPMN 2.0 core it builds on is stable; the Studyflow extensions are still evolving, and breaking changes are noted in [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/behaverse/studyflow-modeler/releases). |

## The project

| Question | Answer |
|:--|:--|
| **How do I cite Studyflow?** | Cite the [repository](https://github.com/behaverse/studyflow-modeler) and the [release](https://github.com/behaverse/studyflow-modeler/releases) you used, and deposit the `.studyflow.yaml` file alongside your data. The modeler writes its version into every studyflow it exports. |
| **Where do I report a bug?** | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/behaverse/studyflow-modeler/issues). For new element types or new schemas, open an issue before sending a pull request. |
